text:
`fact_inventory` now has one row per `inventory_id`: 102 rows and 102 distinct ids, down from 154 rows.

The cause was in the source data. `northwind.inventory_transactions` has 154 rows but only 102 distinct ids. The duplicates are exact copies across every column, and the staging model passes them through unchanged. The fact model selected every row, so each duplicated id appeared twice.

I changed `models/warehouse/fact_inventory.sql` to use `SELECT DISTINCT *` in its final select. Because the duplicate rows are identical, this removes only the copies and keeps all 102 distinct transactions. The rebuild of `fact_inventory` passed.

I did not change the staging model or the source. If the duplicates should be fixed upstream, that would need a look at how the source table is loaded.
